name: vantage-point
description: Vantage Point: a HUD above the Claude Code prompt, and the human queue, where agents queue asks and you rule yes/no with comments, from the desktop or your phone.

readerGist.title: Reader gist
readerGist.description: Ask agents to end a long reply with a short gist, which the RSVP Reader plays first. Off: the gist instruction is left out of the system prompt, and the Reader plays the full reply. Vantage Point still adds the line asking the agent to report its task, and on a branch that names an issue, the line naming that issue.
